Actual bus/tram/train fare between the office and the classes if the distance each way is more than 1.6 km paid under contingencies after obtaining certificate of attendance from the Instructor. In the absence of public transport, two trainees may hire a rickshaw or four trainees a tonga and claim proportionate charges at the fixed rates. · 品
